_comment: The school year, transcribed from 'LOTS 2026-2027 Calendar.png' - the calendar the school
publishes. This file is the single source of truth for it. scripts/load_calendar.mjs writes
it to school_week and school_date, scripts/seed.mjs reads it rather than holding its own
copy, and scripts/ingest_overviews.py reads it to turn a 'Week 5' label in an overview into
a date. Before this file there were two hardcoded tables, in JavaScript and in Python, and
they disagreed from the midterm break onward.
Weeks are numbered within a semester, from the first week students are taught in, because
that is how the school's own curriculum overviews number them. INSET weeks, when only
teachers are in, are recorded in 'dates' rather than as weeks for the same reason.
Transcribed by hand on purpose. It is forty rows once a year, and a date read wrongly by a
model would move a whole term without anybody noticing.

weeks.note: School opens for students. Term 1 begins.
Gradewise orientation for parents, 1 to 4 September.
Afternoon activities start. International Literacy Day on the 8th.
Independence Day celebration on the 14th. Parent conferences on the 13th and 14th.
Midterm break, 19 to 26 October. Students report back on Monday 26 October.
Students report after the midterm break.
School production on the 6th.
Science and Maths fair on the 13th. Last full teaching week of the semester.
Final exam practicals, 16 to 20 November.
Semester 1 final examinations begin on the 23rd.
Examinations end on 2 December. Last day of school for students is 3 December.
Classes resume after the holidays. Term 2 begins for students.
Afterschool activities start for Term 2 on the 18th.
Mock examinations for IGCSE 2 and A Level, 25 January to 4 February.
Mock examinations for IGCSE 2 and A Level continue to the 4th.
Sports Day for Early Years on the 12th.
Sports Day for CP1 to CP6 on the 18th, LS1 to A Level on the 19th.
Leadership camps for LS1, 25 to 27 February.
Checkpoint final examinations for CP6 and LS3, 1 to 12 March. Leadership camps for CP5, 2 to 4 March.
Checkpoint examinations continue to the 12th. Founder's and Culture Day on the 12th.
Leadership camps for CP6, 18 to 20 March.
Inter-house debate on the 25th. Last day of Term 2 is Friday 26 March.
Term 2 break, 26 March to 12 April. Good Friday on 2 April.
Term 2 break continues. Easter Monday on the 5th.
School opens for Term 3. Leadership camp day trips for CP1 to CP4 through the month.
Kenneth Kaunda Day on Tuesday the 20th.
Labour Day on Friday 1 May.
Africa Freedom Day on Monday the 25th.
Last full teaching week before examinations.
End of Semester 2 examinations begin on the 7th for CP onwards.
Examinations conclude on the 18th.
Graduations on the 24th and 25th. Whole school assembly and last day of school on the 25th.
